title: 56 #### 1.7 Offences under Local & Special laws : As against a total of 13,68,529 cognizable cases under the Indian Penal Code registered by the police in 1980, a total of 25,83,700 offences were reported under the Local and Special Laws during 1980 registering a decline of 8.5 percent over the 1979 figures. As compared to 1979, the number of cases registered was less under the Prohibition Act, Gambling Act, Excise Act, Motor Vehicles Act and Prevention of Corruption Act and more under the Arms Act, Opium Act, Explosives and Explosive Substances Act, Suppression of Immoral Traffic in Women and Girls Act, Customs Act, Indian Railways Act and other offences under Local and Special Laws. The States which contributed most to registering cases under Local & Special Laws were Mahasrastra (6,38,091), Tamil Nadu (6,34,234), Karnataka (2,45,175), Andhra Pradesh (2,36,641), Madhya Pradesh (1,83,293), Uttar Pradesh (1,81,848), West Bengal (1,55,756) and Gujarat (1,52,212).
